init_config.title: System Initialization Configuration
init_config.description: Represents the structural setup completion status of the AdBoard platform.

setupCompleted.description: Flag indicating if the first-time setup wizard has been successfully finalized.

setupCompletedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the administrator created the system.

user_profile.title: Administrator Profile
user_profile.description: Models securely verified platform administrators authorized to publish advertisements and modify board configurations.

userId.description: The unique user identifier matching Firebase Authentication UID.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

advertisement_media.title: Advertisement Media Asset
advertisement_media.description: Represents an image or video slide to be displayed on the public kiosk advertisement board.

title.description: Consumer-friendly descriptive title for the advertisement.

url.description: Direct content download URL from storage bucket.

type.description: Underlying file asset core format type.

fileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded slide.

fileSize.description: Size of the database element in bytes.

duration.description: Duration in seconds to display this slide before advancing the carousel.

isActive.description: Status flag to permit rendering on the public display screen.

ownerId.description: The UID of the administrator who uploaded this slide.

display_settings.title: Kiosk Settings
display_settings.description: Consolidated slide pacing, visual effects, and kiosk display parameters.

kioskMode.description: Lock interface down to full-width fullscreen layout hide UI chrome.

autoplaySeconds.description: Default slideshow display pace fallback when media lacks duration override.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated user parameters.

/config/init.description: Houses structural initialization configuration metadata for setup tracking.

/settings/displayConfig.description: Singleton configuration for active display rules.
